where.if: AND ( UPPER(w.WAREHOUSE_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(w.WAREHOUSE_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(w.WAREHOUSE_TYPE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select:
SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_NAME, WAREHOUSE_TYPE, ACTIVE_FLAG, UPDATED_AT FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_warehouse.* FROM ( SELECT w.WAREHOUSE_ID, w.WAREHOUSE_CODE, w.WAREHOUSE_NAME, w.WAREHOUSE_TYPE, w.ACTIVE_FLAG, TO_CHAR( w.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS UPDATED_AT FROM WAREHOUSE w
ORDER BY w.WAREHOUSE_CODE ASC, w.WAREHOUSE_ID ASC ) ordered_warehouse WHERE ROWNUM <= #{page} * #{pageSize} ) WHERE rn > (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize} ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_CODE ASC, WAREHOUSE_ID ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_WAREHOUSE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE ( WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_NAME, WAREHOUSE_TYPE, ACTIVE_FLAG, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseType}, 'Y', LOCALTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE WAREHOUSE SET WAREHOUSE_NAME = #{warehouseName}, WAREHOUSE_TYPE = #{warehouseType}, UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId}

UPDATE WAREHOUSE SET ACTIVE_FLAG = #{activeFlag}, UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID IN
#{warehouseId}
